problems.what: The loudness token is partly carried by the ambience bed, not by the SFX. AMB_CALM_LIFT_DB went 2 -> 3 and MIX_TRIM_DB 3.0 -> 3.5. Integrated ambience is now -23.2 to -23.8 LUFS on every seat (round 1: -25.7 / -26.2; the probe header says 'about -28'), within 0.5-2.4 dB of the whole sfx bus (Kemdo s7: sfx -22.75 vs ambience -23.29). In fights, FIGHT_SFX_DB also eases the sfx bus 3 dB.
problems.evidence: rt_s7 / rt_s21 / rt_s11 loudness: sfx -22.75 / -21.38 / -22.54, ambience -23.29 / -23.24 / -23.83. Engineer's Lisvel s21: sfx -23.01 vs ambience -23.26 (ambience +2.5 dB vs round 1, sfx +0.9).
problems.fix: Pull AMB_CALM_LIFT_DB back toward 2 and carry the master with sfx and kit gain, keeping ambience >= 4 dB under the sfx bus integrated. Re-run probe_audio_runtime match on seeds 3, 7, 11 and 21.

problems.what: The brawling seat sits near the top of the band: seed 3 Lisvel at -16.97 (mine) and -16.92 (engineer), against a top bound of -16.5. One louder kit or a busier seed would cross it.
problems.evidence: rt_s3: out I -16.97, Mmax -7.37; sfx bus -19.04.
problems.fix: Check a few more brawl-heavy seats (for example seeds 3 and 15 with Odrum or Sukri). If they exceed the bound, raise FIGHT_SFX_DB or trim OWN_KIT_DB slightly.

problems.what: The snap-gate exemptions are a self-granted relaxation of the 3 ms onset bar for 8 shared ability hits, and the claim and the record undercount them. f_hesmi_hit is exempt in SNAP_TUNE with no per-cue reason. Worst-take onsets reach 46-51 ms (f_burdam_hit, f_ulkro_hit), not the 5-27 ms the claim states.
problems.evidence: build.py --gates: 'exempt (identity): f_ardit_hit, f_burdam_hit, f_dunsom_hit, f_hesmi_hit, f_kemdo_hit, f_nurrow_hit, f_odrum_hit, f_ulkro_hit'. sfx2c_onset_hf_record.json overThreeMs has 7 entries and no hesmi. My decode of the worst take: hesmi_hit 7.3 ms, burdam_hit 46.1, ulkro_hit 50.9.
problems.fix: Record f_hesmi_hit's reason, report worst-take onsets, and either redesign the identity of the shared lighter-ability slot or get an owner ruling on the exemption.

problems.what: None of the 7 dark kit hits were lifted over the HF floors; all of them were handled by a per-cue record. f_dunsom_attack_hit has 0.00 % above 2 kHz.
problems.fix: Allowed by the brief. Next round, try an identity-safe air layer on tunlan_hit, ulkro_attack_hit and hesmi_attack_hit, which are each within reach of one floor.

problems.what: The claim 'no memory change' is inaccurate: 37 new cues (32 impacts, 5 UI) add decoded AudioBuffers, and probe_match_memory was not re-measured.
problems.evidence: My estimate of the decoded size: 10.5 MB for all cues, about 6.5 MB per 10-fighter match. RIFT match memory 2865 / 3000 MB.
problems.fix: Run probe_match_memory --modes rift --track on an idle machine before release, at the final idle gate.
